Name: (DGA) Sleepy Giant
Author: nwooy
Description:
[center][font=Times New Roman][size=3]﻿Sleepy Giant is my first ever mod I've made for Stardew Valley and I am so excited to share it! I hope others can enjoy it as much as I do <3

This is a very simple mod to install and use within your own game!
[/size][/font]﻿[img]http://thumbs.gfycat.com/MarriedEasyChrysomelid-max-1mb.gif[/img]﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿[/center][font=Trebuchet MS][size=4][b]What's Included?[/b][/size]﻿[/font]

[size=3]A cute and sleepy Totoro for you to place in your farm/town![/size]

[b]What are the requirements?[/b]

[list]
[*][size=3][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9365]Dynamic Game Assets[/url][/size]﻿
[/list]
[size=4][b]How do I install this?

[/b][/size][size=3]Simply put it in to your Stardew Valley mods folder! Make sure to have Dynamic Game Assets installed or this will NOT show up!

[/size][b][size=4]Well, now that it's installed.. Where can I find it?

[/size][/b][size=3]Totoro can be purchased at Robins shop for 100G! Alternatively, what I find to be the quickest option is to install [/size][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/93]CJB Item Spawner[/url][size=3] and spawn the 'Catalogue'. Depending on how many content packs you have for DGA, it might take a while to find Totoro, but he should be near the end of the catalogue in the decorations section! [/size]

[b][size=4]Known Errors﻿/Conflicts

[/size][/b]There are no errors or conflicts that I know of at the moment! I have over 60+ mods installed and have run in to no issues! Although, I only played with the mod in my game for no longer than ten minutes, so if anything goes wrong, please let me know! (But also remember I'm super new to this, I can only do so much, and it might take me a while to learn!) 

[size=4][b]Planned Changes

[/b][/size][size=3]In the future I plan on editing the PNG to make it clearer and POSSIBLY animating. Stay tuned to see what I do!


[/size][b]You may[i] NOT [/i]redistribute this mod on other sites such as ModDrop.
You may[i] NOT [/i]reuse the code for your own DGA mod[i].[/i] I recommend visiting [url=http://github.com/spacechase0/StardewValleyMods/blob/develop/DynamicGameAssets/docs/author-guide.md]this github[/url] page made by spacechase0. 
You[i] CAN[/i] recolour this mod to fit your own aesthetic and [u][i]PERSONAL USE[/i][/u], for those who are brave and patient enough to try, good luck! 

[/b]If you need assistance installing mods, refer to [url=http://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started]t[/url][url=http://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started]he Wiki[/url].
